legenda: Fast melodic hardcore punk, urgent and defiant yet hopeful mood, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese with shouted gang vocals on the chorus, distorted power-chord electric guitars, driving punk bass, fast snare-heavy drums with double-time beats, half-time breakdown in the bridge, raw garage energy, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: Um hardcore melódico de coro gritado sobre classificar cada linha do CIC-IDS2017 e o chamado para o projeto voltar à roda.
descricao: Hardcore melódico com coro gritado sobre o CIC-IDS2017, a floresta aleatória contra o modelo bobo e a meta de noventa por cento.
